name: whisper
description: Whisper speech to text on this computer: talk to LOKI with the mic button in the message box, and send Telegram voice notes. faster-whisper (installed here; the model downloads once, ~145 MB for base) or whisper.cpp (set LOKI_WHISPER_CPP to whisper-cli and put a ggml model in harness_data/models/whisper/). Nothing you say leaves the computer.
